settings.heading: Order tires online.
settings.lede: An online tire and wheel store shipping to any address in the continental United States — or free to our South Florida shop, where we fit them for you.
settings.finder_copy: Shop by vehicle, or by the size stamped on your sidewall.
settings.vehicle_copy: Your tire size is printed on the sticker inside the driver's door, and on the sidewall of the tire itself. No sticker to hand? Answer five questions about your car and get the size and tire type that fit.
settings.vehicle_note: Not sure? Call us and read the sidewall to us.
settings.size_note: Your size is printed on the sidewall, e.g. 225/50R17 — that is a 225 width, 50 aspect ratio and a 17 inch rim.

settings.title: Free shipping on every tire
settings.copy: No minimum and no freight surcharge. The price on the tire is the price that ships.

settings.title: Ships anywhere in the lower 48
settings.copy: Any street address in the continental United States — home, work, or your own installer.

settings.title: Free ship-to-store & install
settings.copy: Send the set to our Sunrise shop at no charge and book the fitting.

settings.title: Fresh, DOT-dated rubber
settings.copy: Shipped direct rather than pulled off a back-room shelf, and the date code on the sidewall shows when it was made.

settings.heading: Start with the kind of tire you need

settings.title: Ship it to me
settings.copy: Your order ships straight to the address you give us — home, work, or your own installer. Shipping is free, and the delivery estimate is shown at checkout before you commit.

settings.title: Ship free to the shop — we'll fit them
settings.copy: Send the order to Extreme Tires — Sunrise at no charge, then book an install. Mounting, balancing, valve stems and disposal of the old set, all handled in the bay.

settings.heading: You choose where the tires land
settings.lede: Same catalog, same prices. The only decision is whether they come to your door or to our door.

settings.title: Decode my tire size
settings.copy: Type what is on your sidewall and see every number explained, drawn to the proportions of your own tire. Compare two sizes and see what actually changes.

settings.title: Find my tires
settings.copy: Five questions about your car, your roads and your weather. You get the size and tire type that fit, and why.

settings.title: Do I need tires yet?
settings.copy: Check the tread with a coin you already have, and the age with the code on the sidewall. If they are fine, it says so.

settings.heading: Not sure what you need? Start here
settings.lede: Three tools that answer the questions that stop people buying tires online. They work whether or not you buy anything from us.
